The servers/employees are very friendly, helpful, and respectful. I definitely will return.

This place is probably one of the better place in Can Tho city. The price and quality is acceptable. The buffet option is probably a better deal than the by-the-dish one. You can try out this place if you want something other than Kichi Kichi or Manwah hotpot. Definitely will come back.
